assertions.note: Blueprint 14.4 step 6: trigger words for the assertion checker (core/sgt_i/assertions.py). One mechanism covers the past-tense rule, the future-stepper rule and the ack gate on every portal - a new portal's wording is a change here, never a code change. 'self' triggers assert their class wherever they appear; 'pre' triggers are generic negators whose scope runs forward from themselves to the next terminator (or the end of the text) - a 'happened' trigger falling inside that scope is negated, not happened (NegEx's own idea, ported from clinical text). Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the lower-cased text.

page_kinds.note: Blueprint 14.4 step 6, second half: generic vocabulary for core/sgt_i/page_kinds.py. These are login/payment/profile/error words shared by many portals ('log in', 'otp', 'pay now', ...), never one portal's own field names - a new portal's wording is a change here, never a code change. Matched case-insensitively as whole words/phrases against heading, dialog and label text.
